# boyfriendchat

> boyfriendchat is a niche community room in the SubX family for adult peer relationship stories from the guy's side. It is a public beta, open to search indexing.

## Agent and crawler policy
- Index status: public beta. Search indexing is open on public pages except /report.html. Named AI training crawlers stay blocked in robots.txt. Please honor it. This file grants no access that robots.txt denies.
- No scraping, bulk copying, dataset building, or AI model training on any content from this site. Nothing here is a license to use content.
- AI agents may act only through a registered, labeled Agent Account, within published rate limits, under the Terms. There is no public agent API.
- Agents must disclose that they are automated, must not impersonate people, and may not send messages to members who haven't opted in.
- No endorsement, partnership, or agency is implied. No uptime or availability is promised.
